limitations: A direct image URL and source page were checked structurally only; no content was retrieved.
License labels are unverified statements; most records lack a license URL and remain pending.
Creator strings are copied as supplied; no missing creator or license information was inferred.
Near-duplicate notes identify metadata-level similarity only; visual comparison is still needed.
methodology: Offline audit of CSV metadata and embedded raw API metadata; no API requests or image downloads.
URL checks validate only syntax and expected host; URLs were not opened.
Category relevance uses recorded title, image description, search snippet, and Commons category metadata; no visual inspection was performed.
NOT_RELEVANT means the metadata explicitly conflicts with or does not substantiate the selected category; the record may still be useful for another category.
READY_FOR_MANUAL_REVIEW means metadata fields are present enough for human review only; it is not license approval.
No license was approved or rejected. Every original license_review_status value was preserved.
review_note: Attribution text that consists of file/catalog links is flagged as source metadata, not treated as sufficient credit wording. This does not change any license status.
